register.labelZh: DINE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: dine on 可以指出一餐所享用的具體食物,例如新鮮魚、當地海鮮或烤雞。；dine on 說明某人吃甚麼;dine out 則表示某人不在家吃飯,通常是到餐廳用餐。；dine out on something 表示反覆講述一段有趣故事,或不斷談論一次特別經歷。；這些 DINE 表達適合用來談論假期、餐廳、慶祝活動和令人難忘的會面。
register.summaryEn: Dine on lets you name the particular food served at a meal, such as fresh fish, local seafood or roast chicken. Dine on tells us what someone eats. Dine out tells us that the person eats away from home, usually at a restaurant. Dine out on something describes repeatedly telling an interesting story or talking about a special experience. These DINE expressions are useful when talking about holidays, restaurants, celebrations and memorable meetings.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Notice the three different meanings: ● dine on something = eat a particular kind of food ● dine out = eat at a restaurant ● dine out on something = keep telling people about an interesting experience The core expressions are dine on something, dine out and dine out on something. Details such as every night, at a restaurant and for years are optional and may appear in different places in a sentence.
